findings.description: The cycle-detection guard (`seen` set) was removed from the `__cause__` chain walk, so a cyclic cause chain now loops forever.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the retried function raises an exception whose `__cause__` chain loops back on itself (e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, which Python permits) and neither exception is an instance of `exception_cause_types`. The loop `while exc is not None` never terminates because `exc = exc.__cause__` keeps cycling. Impact: the retry predicate hangs the process in an infinite loop instead of returning False.
